metrics.name: group_completion_rate
metrics.pm_question: Completion rate (group_started -> group_submitted) by group size — where do large groups fall off?
metrics.formula: uniq(group_id WHERE event='group_submitted') / uniq(group_id WHERE event='group_started')

metrics.name: traveller_churn
metrics.pm_question: Travellers added vs removed per group; add/remove churn?

metrics.name: docs_incomplete_share
metrics.pm_question: Is per-traveller docs_complete the bottleneck for big groups?

deviations: D1: skip-indexed paths (os, docs_complete) are typed in the JSON hint (required — untyped set/bloom on JSON paths errors with Code 36).
D2: aggregate table TTL keyed on event_date (not ch_insert_time) since the agg has no insert watermark.
D3: group_id indexed via CAST(...) bloom_filter because it is the metric unit but not in the ORDER BY key.
D4: MV uses uniqIfState (not uniqState+if(...NULL)) to keep AggregateFunction(uniq, String) non-nullable and match the target column type.
